unit.why: A single anecdote, told by R. Yehudah Leib of Nesukhoyiz, about the Rav of Berdichev waking sleeping guests at midnight to offer them brandy so he could compare a Jew with a non-Jew.

stories.end_quote: רבש״ע ראה מה בין אלו לאלו
stories.summary_en: At midnight the Rav of Berdichev took brandy to the bathhouse where homeless guests slept; a woken Jew refused to drink without water for hand-washing and a place to bless, while a non-Jew drank at once without a blessing, and the Rav joyfully pleaded before God: see the difference between these and those.
